facts.text: The Ocean Front rooms sit directly along the shoreline, with uninterrupted ocean views from a private balcony.
facts.excerpt: Ocean Front Double & King Rooms Serene retreats positioned directly along the shoreline, with uninterrupted ocean views from a private balcony.

facts.text: The Ocean Front Lanai Terrace Suites are ground-level suites with private terraces opening directly to the Atlantic and poolside living.
facts.excerpt: Ocean Front Lanai Terrace Suites Generous ground-level suites with private terraces opening directly to the Atlantic and poolside living.

facts.text: The Lanai Terrace Rooms are ground-level rooms with a private patio terrace and easy access to the pools and the beach.
facts.excerpt: Lanai Terrace Rooms Generous ground-level rooms with a private patio terrace and easy access to pools and the beach.

facts.text: Club Level rooms and suites come with exclusive Club Level access and lounge privileges.
facts.excerpt: enhanced by exclusive Club Level access and lounge privileges.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has expansive living spaces and panoramic ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Presidential Suite Some places stay with you. A refined residential retreat with expansive living spaces and panoramic ocean views.

facts.text: The Resort View rooms each have a private balcony with views across the resort's gardens and grounds.
facts.excerpt: each featuring a private balcony with views across the resort’s gardens and grounds.

facts.text: Eau Spa has its own spa restaurant, Savor, serving fresh salads, bowls and wellness-focused cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Located within Eau Spa, Savor offers fresh salads, bowls, and wellness-focused cuisine, ideal for a light lunch or post-treatment refresh.

facts.text: The resort has Kids and Teen Clubs.
facts.excerpt: Kids & Teen Clubs Freedom to roam with space to grow.
Water Sports Open water meets personal playground.
Tennis Set point. Play at your pace.
Private Daybeds For shaded moments and times of stillness.

facts.text: Nobu Manalapan, at the resort, serves Nobu Matsuhisa's Japanese cuisine with Peruvian influences, including Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Jalapeno.
facts.excerpt: Discover Nobu’s signature approach to Japanese cuisine with Peruvian influences, from Black Cod Miso and Yellowtail Jalapeño to meticulously prepared sushi and sashimi.

facts.text: Breeze Ocean Kitchen is an oceanfront restaurant open for lunch and relaxed dinner, with a Sunday brunch.
facts.excerpt: An oceanfront restaurant in Palm Beach, open throughout the day for lunch and relaxed dinner service. The menu focuses on fresh, coastal ingredients in a casual setting, with a special Sunday brunch offering.

facts.text: In the evenings at Stir, guests can gather by the firepit or on the outdoor terrace, or enjoy live music in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: In the evenings, gather by the firepit or on the outdoor terrace—both inviting spots to unwind—or enjoy live music in the lobby

facts.text: Oceana is a cafe for coffee, pastries and light bites, and the Melt ice cream cart serves house-made flavors by the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Don’t miss the Melt ice cream cart, serving house-made flavors for a refreshing treat by the ocean.

facts.text: Non-hotel guests are welcome at the restaurants, and reservations are recommended.
facts.excerpt: Non-hotel guests are welcome at our Palm Beach restaurants, though reservations are recommended and availability may vary.

facts.text: The resort hosts weddings and events along Palm Beach's shoreline.
facts.excerpt: here, along Palm Beach’s sparkling shoreline, weddings and events display a natural rhythm.
